title: Vast button
description: A flat, 2px-radius rectangle button with a small medium-weight label. Dark (primary), white (for photos) or a thin outline. Hover dims it slightly over 0.5s.
notes: variant light is made for photos and dark bands
name: vastspace-button

props.name: href
props.description: where it links; leave out to render a <button> (e.g. a form submit)

props.name: variant
props.description: dark: filled black · light: white fill, for photos · outline: thin dark outline

props.name: type
props.description: button type when there is no href
